title: Isobavachin Attenuates Renal and Cardiac Injury in Chronic Hyperuricemia via Modulation of NF-kappaB and NLRP3 Signaling Pathways.
authors: Li, Yongmei; Xu, Yuexin; Ye, Wenjie; Yu, Zeqi; Wu, Zhenkun; Liu, Xinyi; Huang, Xuhong; Pang, Jianxin; Zhao, Zean; Wu, Ting
journal: Journal of biochemical and molecular toxicology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究异黄酮类化合物Isobavachin通过NF-kappaB和NLRP3通路缓解高尿酸血症肾心损伤，仅涉及分子对接且非蛋白质-DNA互作核心，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Hyperuricaemia (HUA) is a recognized risk factor for cardiovascular and renal diseases. Isobavachin, a dihydroflavone derivative, demonstrates significant efficacy in reducing uric acid levels. This study investigated the nephroprotective and cardioprotective effects and molecular mechanisms of isobavachin. Through integrative network pharmacology, pathway enrichment analysis, and molecular docking, NF-kappaB was identified as a potential target of isobavachin in the context of hyperuricemia-related cardiac and renal injury. Isobavachin treatment inhibited the activation of the NF-kappaB pathway, leading to cytoprotection in uric acid (UA)-stimulated mRTEC and H9C2 cells. In chronic HUA mice, isobavachin treatment significantly improved renal pathology and reduced renal collagen deposition by inhibiting epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition. Isobavachin administration demonstrated therapeutic efficacy in attenuating myocardial injury, hypertrophy, and fibrotic remodeling. Notably, the anti-inflammatory effects of isobavachin were particularly evident in both renal and cardiac tissues, primarily mediated through its dual regulatory capacity in suppressing NF-kappaB pathway activation and NLRP3 inflammasome formation. In conclusion, isobavachin ameliorated cardiac and renal damage caused by chronic HUA, suggesting a new strategy to prevent HUA.
abstract_zh: 高尿酸血症（HUA）是心血管和肾脏疾病的公认风险因素。异补骨脂查尔酮（Isobavachin）作为一种二氢黄酮衍生物，在降低尿酸水平方面显示出显著疗效。本研究探讨了异补骨脂查尔酮的肾脏保护和心脏保护作用及其分子机制。通过整合网络药理学、通路富集分析和分子对接，NF-kappaB被确定为异补骨脂查尔酮在高尿酸血症相关心脏和肾脏损伤中的潜在靶点。异补骨脂查尔酮处理抑制了NF-kappaB通路的激活，从而在尿酸（UA）刺激的mRTEC和H9C2细胞中发挥细胞保护作用。在慢性HUA小鼠中，异补骨脂查尔酮处理通过抑制上皮-间质转化显著改善了肾脏病理并减少了肾胶原沉积。异补骨脂查尔酮给药在减轻心肌损伤、肥大和纤维化重塑方面显示出治疗功效。值得注意的是，异补骨脂查尔酮的抗炎作用在肾脏和心脏组织中尤为明显，主要通过其抑制NF-kappaB通路激活和NLRP3炎症小体形成的双重调节能力介导。总之，异补骨脂查尔酮改善了慢性HUA引起的心脏和肾脏损伤，为预防HUA提供了一种新策略。
